title: Quran Study 49: Code 19 and the Heavenly Feud (1989-11-05)
source_file: data/sources/playlists/audio-transcripts/49 - Quran Study 49 Speech Of Rashad Parivash_s Home 19 Math 11 05 1989.csv
document_summary: Behrouz introduces Rashad for a concentrated forty-minute presentation. Rashad describes the Quran as a universally accessible perpetual mathematical miracle and places nineteen within astronomy, calendars, anatomy, embryology, Quranic verse sequences, occurrences of God, and the sum of all numbers mentioned in the Quran. He then explains the heavenly feud, Satan's claim to rule independently, the classification of angels, animals, humans, and jinn, the second chance, natural instinct through Abraham, and disease and AIDS as evidence of Satan's inability to run a perfect dominion.

related_duplicate_sources.note: Audit shared totals once rather than treating them as independent.

The audio combines it directly with the mathematical presentation.
